name: Ash vacuum
definition: vacuum cleaner with a metal container and fire-resistant filter made to pick up cold ash from fireplaces, stoves and grills.
reason: Sold as its own category (Kärcher); metal body and filter for ash differ from every body-form kind, like the wet-and-dry special use.

name: Electric mop (powered rotating mop)
definition: cordless mop whose motor drives rotating pads or rollers that wipe the floor, with no suction and no steam.
reason: Motor-driven head changes the form (rule T, C10 b); no suction, so not the floor washer; own shop category.
Wet roller plus suction is the floor-washer form; "vacuum mop" is Kärcher's category word, an alias.
Kärcher S 4/S 6 sweep yards, paths and drives: key step 29 (keeping grounds, paths and drives), C2.4.

name: String mop (strand mop)
definition: mop whose head is a bundle of cotton or synthetic strands, wrung by hand or in a bucket wringer.
reason: Head form differs from flat, sponge and spin heads; Lowe's shelves it apart. Alias clash: "wet mop" also names B6.1.3.02.
Sprays and extracts carpet or upholstery: the carpet cleaning machine; size is an attribute (SpotClean already filed there).

name: Drain unblocker
definition: gel, liquid or granules poured into a sink or drain to dissolve blockages of grease, hair and soap.
reason: A cleaning product (S3) with its own soil and action; the snake and plunger stay C1.

name: Cleaning wipe
definition: disposable cloth sold pre-moistened with a cleaning or disinfecting liquid.
reason: Sold under its own name and shelf; a cloth form, so it joins the cloths leaf; antibacterial is an attribute.
Same soil and action as toilet cleaner; block, rim cage or cistern tablet is a form attribute of the kind.

name: Toilet brush
definition: long-handled round brush, usually kept in a holder, made to scrub the toilet bowl.
reason: Distinct form from the scrub brush and sold everywhere under its own name; a cleaning tool, so B6 not B7.
Gloves worn to protect the hands: key step 17, A1 glove and protective clothing, tried before step 30.
Room-named retail line, an alias (tree: never the room); its job is limescale and soap scum.
Grout is a surface; surface is an attribute in B6.2.4; mould on grout is B6.2.4.07.
The carpet cleaning machine is defined for carpet or upholstery.
Same scrubber body with self-navigation; navigation is a stored attribute (memo section 14).
Feather duster kind is feathers or fibres on a handle; fibre is a material attribute.

name: Detergent sheet (laundry sheet or tile)
definition: pre-dosed dry laundry detergent pressed into a dissolving sheet or tile.
reason: Leaf axis is physical form; a sheet is neither powder, liquid nor capsule (Tide evo shelved apart).

name: Dishwasher cleaner
definition: product made to clean the inside of a dishwasher, its filter, spray arms and pipes.
reason: Parallels washing-machine cleaner B6.3.6.05; Finish sells it as its own product type.

name: Dishwasher freshener
definition: clip-in or hanging product made to remove odours from inside a dishwasher.
reason: Removes odour from a machine, so B6 (boundary 16); own shop type, different form from a cleaner.
One maker's dishwasher additive (Finish), no generic shelf name; nearest kind is the rinse-aid additive.
B6.4 kinds go by use; a spray dispenser of hand dish detergent is a form attribute of washing-up liquid.

candidate: Rotary washing line, washing line and pole
reason: Airer kind is a rack or line for hanging washing; rotary, line or pole is form attribute.

name: Ironing board cover
definition: padded fabric cover made to fit an ironing board.
reason: Part made for one object (S3); no leaf serves ironing boards, so new leaf B6.6.4 (object served).
Lint remover is defined as roller, brush or powered shaver.
IronCare water filter GC024 removes scale from the iron's water: the anti-scale cartridge kind.

name: Iron soleplate cleaner
definition: stick, paste or kit made to clean residue and scale from an iron's soleplate.
reason: Cleaning product for one object (S3), axis object cared for; not a descaler; check the page at attestation.
Compartments are an attribute of the bin (tree).

name: Sack holder (bin-bag holder)
definition: open frame or hoop on a stand that holds a bin bag or refuse sack open, with or without a lid.
reason: No body to hold waste, so not the kitchen bin; check the page at attestation (not in the logged gave column).
A bin for one waste stream: compartments and use are attributes; outdoor kerbside boxes go with the wheelie bin.
Bin liner kind; compostable material is an attribute.

name: Laundry pedestal
definition: drawer or stand made to raise a washing machine or dryer, with no washer inside.
reason: Accessory made for one object (S3); the pedestal washer B6.3.1.07 is a machine, the plain pedestal is not.

name: Stacking kit
definition: frame or bracket kit made to stack a dryer on top of a washing machine.
reason: Accessory made for washers and dryers (S3), sold under its own name.
Adds scent to laundry: scent booster; where it is dosed (drum or dryer) is an attribute.

name: Dryer sheet
definition: non-woven sheet carrying softener and scent, tumbled with laundry in a dryer.
reason: Own form and shelf (US); not added to the rinse, so not fabric conditioner. No logged page: HV_NK.

name: Vacuum hose
definition: flexible hose made to fit a vacuum cleaner.
reason: Part type sold under its own name in spares shops; B6.6.1 kind axis is part type.

name: Brush roll
definition: rotating brush bar made to fit a vacuum cleaner's floor head.
reason: Electrolux spares list brushrolls apart from nozzles and belts.

name: Vacuum motor
definition: suction motor made to fit a vacuum cleaner.
reason: Part type in spares shops; not a nozzle, belt or battery.

name: Vacuum wheel
definition: wheel or castor made to fit a vacuum cleaner body or head.
reason: Part type in spares shops.

name: Vacuum wand (extension tube)
definition: rigid tube made to join a vacuum cleaner's hose or body to its floor head.
reason: Part type in spares shops; distinct from the hose and the nozzle.

name: Drain pump
definition: pump made to empty water from a washing machine or dryer.
reason: Washer and dryer spare part type (section 14 leaf).

name: Drum paddle (lifter)
definition: ribbed paddle fixed inside a washing-machine or dryer drum that lifts the load.
reason: Washer and dryer spare part type.

name: Carbon brush
definition: carbon motor brush made for a washing machine or dryer motor.
reason: Washer and dryer spare part type.

name: Heater element
definition: heating element made for a washing machine or tumble dryer.
reason: Washer and dryer spare part type.

name: Door lock (interlock)
definition: lock or interlock made to hold a washing-machine or dryer door shut while it runs.
reason: Washer and dryer spare part type.

name: Condenser water container
definition: removable tank made to collect water in a condenser or heat-pump dryer.
reason: Dryer spare part type.

name: Dryer vent hose
definition: flexible duct made to carry moist air from a vented dryer.
reason: Beko spares list vent hose; the inlet or drain hose carries water, not air.

name: Crease-release and ironing spray
definition: spray (crease releaser, starch or ironing water) that relaxes creases or eases ironing.
reason: Own shelf name; no other textile-care kind does it. Search excerpt only: HV_NK.

name: Peg bag
definition: bag or basket made to hold clothes pegs, often hung on the line.
reason: Shop category "pegs and peg storage" (Dunelm); holds pegs, not washing, so not the laundry basket.
An in-wash stain booster is the stain remover used during washing.
Wash-in against spray is a form attribute; the kind definition should read "spray or wash-in".
